name: @queenswood/excalidraw
description: Headless light/dark SVG export for the Excalidraw scenes in docs/diagrams.
$comment: Not a member of the root yarn workspace, so it carries its own lockfile. infra/docker/console/Dockerfile copies every member's package.json and runs `yarn install --immutable`; membership would pull React, esbuild and a Playwright Chromium into the console image build.
